prelude: EXTERN STRUCT CompilerRegex {} FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN STRUCT CompilerRegexScanner {} CLOSE "deinit" FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexCompile(pattern: String) RETURNS CompilerRegex EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexPattern(regex: CompilerRegex) RETURNS regex:String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexMatch(subject: String, regex: CompilerRegex) RETURNS Bool EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexMatchData(subject: String, regex: CompilerRegex) RETURNS ?CompilerRegexScanner EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexFirstMatch(subject: String, regex: CompilerRegex) RETURNS subject:?String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexMatchGroup(subject: String, regex: CompilerRegex, index: Int64) RETURNS subject:?String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexReplaceAll(subject: String, regex: CompilerRegex, replacement: String) RETURNS String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexReplaceFirst(subject: String, regex: CompilerRegex, replacement: String) RETURNS String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexEscape(value: String) RETURNS String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexScanner(source: String) RETURNS CompilerRegexScanner EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexScan(scanner: CompilerRegexScanner, regex: CompilerRegex) RETURNS Bool EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexScanValue(scanner: CompilerRegexScanner, regex: CompilerRegex) RETURNS scanner:?String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexMatched(scanner: CompilerRegexScanner) RETURNS scanner:String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexCapture(scanner: CompilerRegexScanner, index: Int64) RETURNS scanner:String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexPeek(scanner: CompilerRegexScanner, count: Int64) RETURNS scanner:String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexGetch(scanner: CompilerRegexScanner) RETURNS scanner:?String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexEos(scanner: CompilerRegexScanner) RETURNS Bool EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRegexPosition(scanner: CompilerRegexScanner) RETURNS Int64 EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerCodepointToString(codepoint: UInt64) RETURNS String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerCountOccurrences(text: String, needle: String) RETURNS Int64 EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerLastIndex(text: String, needle: String) RETURNS Int64 EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerFormatTemplate(template: String) RETURNS template:String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerInspectValue() RETURNS String@symbol EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerRepeatString(value: String, count: Int64) RETURNS String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerParseUInt(digits: String, base: Int64) RETURNS !UInt64 EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerZigTranslateC(zig: String, source_dir: String, header_path: String) RETURNS !String EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
EXTERN FN compilerZigExecutable() RETURNS String@symbol EFFECTS :safe FROM "compiler_regex";
